title: One-Pan Cheesy Chicken & Rice
subtitle: chicken, rice and broccoli simmered together in one pan and finished with old cheddar: a weeknight casserole without the oven
imageAlt: Creamy cheesy rice with chicken and broccoli in a skillet, a serving in a white bowl, on a navy napkin
servingsNote: dinner for one big eater + one hungry eater, plus 2 lunches

beforeYouStart.text: Use a large deep skillet or sauté pan with a tight lid, at least 30 cm across.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high and brown the chicken 4–5 minutes, stirring once or twice; it finishes cooking with the rice. Move to a plate.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium. Melt the butter and cook the onion 4 minutes, then the garlic and rice 1 minute, stirring.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the broth and the chicken with its juices and bring to a boil. Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer 12 minutes.

steps.title: Broccoli
steps.text: Scatter the broccoli over the top, cover again and cook 6–8 minutes more, until the rice is tender, the liquid is absorbed and the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F).

steps.title: Cheese
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the milk and cheddar until creamy. Rest 2 minutes before serving.

fixIt.problem: Rice still hard but the pan is dry
fixIt.fix: Add ¼ cup hot water or broth, cover and cook 3–4 minutes more on low.
The heat was above low. Keep it at the lowest steady simmer and don't lift the lid early.
Stir it in off the heat with the milk; shred your own from a block for the smoothest sauce.

saleTip: Broccoli crowns are often under $2 at No Frills; frozen florets work too, added straight from frozen.
swap: Boneless thighs: same amount, same method; they stay even juicier. Still 74°C (165°F).
leftovers: Add a splash of milk when reheating; it firms up in the fridge.
doneness: Chicken pieces at 74°C (165°F) (Health Canada, poultry pieces). Reheat to 74°C (165°F).
source: Based on tested one-pan cheesy chicken, broccoli and rice methods (Canadian Living, Budget Bytes): browned chicken, rice simmered in broth, broccoli steamed on top, cheddar stirred in at the end.
prepAhead: Cut the chicken and broccoli up to 1 day ahead.
Best fresh; it reheats well for lunches.
reheat: Covered in the microwave with a splash of milk, 2–3 minutes, stirring halfway, until 74°C (165°F).

basic.note: Chicken, rice and cheddar; no broccoli or garlic.

stepNotes.4: Basic: no broccoli; cover and cook the last 6–8 minutes as written.

fancy.note: A crunchy buttered crumb and cheddar top, browned under the broiler.

addSteps.title: Fancy topping
addSteps.text: Heat the broiler. Toss the panko with the melted butter, scatter it and the extra cheddar over the pan (it must be oven-safe) and broil 2–3 minutes, watching closely, until golden.

plating: Serve from the skillet at the table.
Scoop deep so everyone gets the crunchy top.

why.1-3: Toasting the rice in butter keeps the grains separate and adds a nutty flavour.
why.1-5: Broccoli steams on top of the rice for the last few minutes, so it stays bright, not mushy.
why.1-7: Old cheddar gives real cheese flavour with less of it.

funFact: Chicken, broccoli and rice casserole was a 1970s potluck classic, usually made with canned soup; this one uses none.

keeps.note: the rice goes grainy and the sauce splits
